titulo.estudio: Une annonce d'études et d'emploi : Repérer les informations
titulo.alumno: An advert for study and work: Finding the details

intro: Pick out the profile requested, the tasks, the hours and the application deadline in an advert. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

texto: Pick out the profile requested, the tasks, the hours and the application deadline in an advert. Separate the fact from its context: verb tenses, connectors and who says what show when and by whom each piece of information is given.
Watch out: relative clauses specify the job; « dont » can refer back to a noun introduced by « de ». In this passage, «poste» means «job».

frases.estudio: La médiathèque recherche un étudiant qui connaît bien les outils numériques pour aider le public.
frases.alumno: The media library is looking for a student who knows digital tools well to help the public.

frases.estudio: Le poste comprend l'accueil des visiteurs et la préparation d'ateliers, dont un rendez-vous hebdomadaire pour les débutants.
frases.alumno: The job includes welcoming visitors and preparing workshops, one of which is a weekly session for beginners.
